set.body: Complete the benchmark-gated UInt8/UInt16 implementation required by image4s. HEAD 160690d already contains the opaque types, DType tags/evidence, initial primitive storage, fixed-rank access, and prepared stencil executors. The worktree has uncommitted follow-up changes extending casts, policy conversion, copy/assign, ordered element kernels, reductions, normalized JS/JVM raw access, and initial representation tests. Acceptance: checked construction; IntegralDType without ArithmeticDType; unsigned widening/comparison; JVM Array[Byte]/Array[Short] and Scala.js Uint8Array/Uint16Array proofs; fixed-rank and sequential kernels without per-element allocation; documented image4s NIfTI migration path.
set.title: Finish UInt8/UInt16 cross-platform dtype integration
